import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone

EXP=Path('/Users/alexy/src/grust/docs/reviews/sail-stream-experiments-2026-09-30')
PACKAGE=Path('/private/tmp/physical-pair-closed-v4-bundle')
OUT=EXP/'host-pair-physical-execution'
DIGEST='55941c6758529696dc088eec37077cbddd3d1fbf8f4868d182435c04c062c5e4'
ROOT='/Users/alexy/src/sail-extensions-gates/stream-experiments-20260930'
REMOTE_PACKAGE=ROOT+'/physical-pair-v4-55941c675852-bundle'
REMOTE_OUTPUT=ROOT+'/physical-pair-v4-55941c675852-evidence'

def utc(): return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
def sha(p):
    with p.open('rb') as f: return hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
def save(p,x):
    with p.open('x') as f: json.dump(x,f,indent=2); f.write('\n')

assert sha(PACKAGE/'pair-requests.json')==DIGEST
manifest=json.loads((PACKAGE/'pair-requests.json').read_text())
assert manifest['run_pair_sha256']=='e0dcd737124d0b4e87f33c25871580be892af54d92b0b441f50c4a6562b79e9a'
assert manifest['original_ratio_eligible'] is True and len(manifest['cells'])==6
for cell in manifest['cells']:
    p=PACKAGE/cell['request']; assert sha(p)==cell['request_sha256']
    request=json.loads(p.read_text())
    for name,pin in request['files'].items():
        assert sha(p.parent/name)==pin['sha256'] and (p.parent/name).stat().st_size==pin['bytes']
assert not any(p.is_symlink() for p in PACKAGE.rglob('*'))
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
report=dict(started_utc=utc(),request_sha256=DIGEST,commands=[],launched=False,
            driver_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),driver_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)),
            remote_package=REMOTE_PACKAGE,remote_output=REMOTE_OUTPUT,
            scope='Supplemental serial physical checks only after all six original trials closed and collection passed. No benchmark rerun or altered outcome.')
save(OUT/'intent.json',report)
def run(label,args,timeout=120):
    row=dict(label=label,command=args,started_utc=utc());report['commands'].append(row)
    with (OUT/(label+'.stdout')).open('xb') as out,(OUT/(label+'.stderr')).open('xb') as err:
        p=subprocess.run(args,stdout=out,stderr=err,timeout=timeout)
    row.update(finished_utc=utc(),returncode=p.returncode)
    for suffix in ('stdout','stderr'):
        f=OUT/(label+'.'+suffix);row[suffix]=dict(path=f.name,bytes=f.stat().st_size,sha256=sha(f))
    p.check_returncode()
    return (OUT/(label+'.stdout')).read_text()
try:
    code='from pathlib import Path; b=Path('+repr(REMOTE_PACKAGE)+'); o=Path('+repr(REMOTE_OUTPUT)+'); assert not b.exists() and not o.exists(); b.mkdir(mode=0o755); b.chmod(0o755)'
    run('remote-new-directory',['ssh','morrobay','/usr/local/bin/python3 -I -B -c '+shlex.quote(code)])
    run('stage',['scp','-rp',*[str(p) for p in sorted(PACKAGE.iterdir())],'morrobay:'+REMOTE_PACKAGE+'/'])
    command=['/usr/local/bin/python3','-I','-B',REMOTE_PACKAGE+'/run_pair.py','--request',REMOTE_PACKAGE+'/pair-requests.json','--request-sha256',DIGEST,'--output',REMOTE_OUTPUT]
    dry=json.loads(run('dry',['ssh','morrobay',shlex.join(command)]));assert dry['prepared_only'] is True
    save(OUT/'dry.json',dry)
    launch=json.loads(run('launch',['ssh','morrobay',shlex.join(command+['--execute-after-closure'])]))
    assert type(launch['pid']) is int and launch['output']==REMOTE_OUTPUT
    report.update(launched=True,launch=launch)
except BaseException as error:
    report['error']=repr(error);raise
finally:
    report['finished_utc']=utc();save(OUT/'staging-launch.json',report)
print(json.dumps(dict(launched=report['launched'],launch=report.get('launch'))))
scope: Supplemental serial physical checks only after all six original trials closed and collection passed. No benchmark rerun or altered outcome.
